propositions: LLM step failures that do not abort the run are silent in plan-review verdict output, making repeated non-fatal degradation invisible to callers.
Failed LLM calls from ~13 swallow sites across src/rebar/llm/ log warnings but produce no in-verdict counter; empty overlap[] from dead batches is byte-identical to empty overlap[] from no matches.

A run-scoped contextvar sink in step_failures.py records failures at the single PydanticAIRunner.run seam and drains into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation safety.
coverage.llm_step_failures is shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<call_label>: <int>}} and must not alter verdict string, exit code, or any existing failure/swallow behavior.
The failure counter is drained in the plan-review scope only; review-code and verify-completion are deliberately out of scope.
